 Republican Rep Ashley Hinson and Democratic state Rep. Josh Turek are competing to replace retiring GOP Sen. Joni Ernst. Hinson has Trump’s endorsement and broadly supports the president's agenda. Democrats have not won a Senate race in Iowa since 2008.
